strategy: OrderBookRecovery; unchanged signal rules; bounded risk; paper replay only

chronology.timezone: UTC; naive ISO values below are explicitly UTC
chronology.rule: No evaluation inspection/tuning/pair selection. Any development change requires new plan version and seal before evaluation collection.

fee_assumptions.exact_account_tiers: unavailable; public taker metadata is not account verification
fee_assumptions.funding: primary uses settled public rates plus settlement mark only where available; missing is explicit, not zero evidence

data_quality_requirements.futures_identity: active linear USDT settled perpetual; no spot substitutes
data_quality_requirements.depth_unit: base asset after exactly one contracts * contractSize conversion
data_quality_requirements.incompatible_or_stale_sources: excluded, not forward filled beyond frozen freshness window
data_quality_requirements.missing_fees_funding_marks: disclosed; primary exact-cost verdict inconclusive; assumptions tested separately

baseline: raw-price momentum comparator only, identical realistic cost assumptions; not complete historic production reconstruction
selection_policy: No automatic winning pair. Development only may inform a new pre-evaluation protocol version; evaluation is confirmatory reporting of all predeclared pairs, never selection/tuning.
statistics_policy: 100 trades is a screening minimum, not significance. Before any edge claim: confidence intervals/dependence-aware bootstrap, multiple-comparison handling, regime and cost sensitivity review.
